subject: Why the Friends List broke and how it was fixed...
author: umopapisdnpuaq
body:
As part of my ongoing RPG with EA Support I managed to level up and reach higher tiers until eventually I got the problem sorted out.

Here is the end of game message response explaining things.

Umo: "I really would appreciate if you have any updates as to what the issue was or how it got fixed."

EA Support Final Boss "The issue was corrected when I kept telling the server team that there was something going on and that forced the server team to take a good look at the servers and they found and corrected the issue. Apparantly it was caused because of the last update to the servers. It caused the servers not to transmit the correct information even though our reporting tools saw it as correct and that there was no issue with the server."

So if it happens again, hopefully we can skip straight to this bit and not be in the wilderness for a couple months :)

subject: There is a close substitute
author: MasquedWarrior
body:
ZombieTron mentioned the possibility (or lack thereof,) of tunneling this game, in order to play it online after the shutdown. Because Burnout 3 has no LAN mode, (system link,) it can't be tunneled, as she noted.

However, something I had brought up a few times during a few games of Burnout 3 during its final few days, the PSP Burnout games both feature LAN play, and XLink Kai supports the PSP. Unfortunately, only certain specific hardware configurations support it: http://teamxlink.co.uk/wiki/doku.php?id=evo7:psp I do not own a PSP, but I have used Xlink Kai with a Playstation 2 and a Gamecube. I am interested in trying to play the PSP Burnout games online using Xlink Kai in the future.
